Stacked bar chart of peptide proportions by Length_range and Condition

Source: R/plots.R
plot_prop_length_condition.Rd

Plots the table produced by count_ids_condition_bylengthrange() as a stacked proportion bar chart per condition, with percentage labels.

Usage

plot_prop_length_condition(
  input,
  level2plot = "Peptides",
  label_size = 3,
  palette = NULL,
  x_var = "Condition"
)

Arguments

input

Output of count_ids_condition_bylengthrange().

level2plot

Which Level to plot — one of "Peptides.Modified", "Peptides", "Proteins".

label_size

Text size for the percentage labels (geom_text); mirrors the report's PlotTextLabelSize param.

palette

Optional named character vector mapping Length_range values to fill colours. When NULL (default) scale_fill_viridis_d() is used.

x_var

Name of the column to map to the x-axis. Default "Condition"; pass "Sample" for the sample-level proportion plot.

Value

A ggplot2 stacked bar chart.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_prop_length_condition(count_ids_condition_bylengthrange(pep_all))
plot_prop_length_condition(count_ids_condition_bylengthrange(pep_all, "Sample"),
                           x_var = "Sample")
} # }
